notes: Profile: mid-market SaaS that powers conversational workflows for retailers (support + returns automation)
Primary persona: Head of Product (Elise Carter) + Eng Lead (Ramon Diaz). Purchasing by Finance after security signoff.
Why Redwood: liked unified API + signal that Dedicated exists for predictable throughput. Wants ability to start on Hosted.
Workload specifics: agentic multi-step flows - search docs -> call internal order API -> reconcile -> emit ticket. Typical chain length 2-4 tool-calls.
Latency SLOs: target p50 token latency <200ms for streaming; p95 end-to-end agent step <800ms; aim for <2s for a multi-step action in 90% of cases.
Streaming + function-calls critical: need partial outputs to UI while long-running tool actions occur.
Key POC metrics: tool-call reliability under 5% failure, median tool-call latency, end-to-end success rate, token-cost per session.
Concerns raised on call: "If a tool-call times out mid-plan, how does agent recover?" — wants clear retry/fallback semantics and observability.
Observed in dry-run: when backend action slow (API 700ms), agenter retries produced duplicated side-effects in our harness — customer wants idempotency guarantees + guidance.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-market — will evaluate Hosted TCO first; Dedicated considered if committed ARR and predictable latency/cost wins.
Procurement note: Finance needs 3 vendor references and AP terms (Net-45).
Drive artifacts: pricing deck, streaming-demo notebook, agentic-workflow-specs.
Next demo planned: live POC demo with error-injection (simulate tool timeouts) 2026-03-20. SE to produce test harness config.
